sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 239 coded subject rows and 77 unnumbered sketch artists across 16 sections are reconciled against original physical PDF rows. LC Lump of Coal is retained; the 50-card base and both 25-row Characters A/B lists remain separate. The wrapped Jordan "Slippa Chervascus" Gumbrell artist is a single entry. Printed CCA-GTA and CCA-MRO differ from their non-autograph codes; all original titles and spellings are retained. The official product landing page supplies odds absent from the global catalog: all 70 Hobby categories retain 65 literal ratios and five unlisted Present Mini values. No ratio unit is named. Exact guide joins number only Base Cards Candy Cane /299 and Snowcaps /5; extended character allocation, illustrated insert examples and other numbering remain qualified. Box contents and store availability are not pack odds or a verified general release date. Exhaustive parallel reconciliation remains incomplete.

The guide extends Candy Cane /299 to a 25-character subset, but the checklist prints distinct Characters A and B rosters; their distribution is not resolved. Keep the extended-subset claim qualified without applying it to either physical program.

Snowcap /5 insert illustrations are card-specific examples. The guide’s general multiple-insert statement does not identify an exhaustive family list; no numbering is propagated to other rows or relics.
Other serial-number ladders and exhaustive parallel coverage remain unverified; color names alone never establish limits.

All 70 Hobby categories are retained, including five Present Mini categories with literal dashes. No ratio unit is named, and the box-topper, rip-card and mini distribution units remain unverified; do not compute per-pack rates.
A general calendar release date remains unverified; store October 6 availability and September 23 guide publication are separate facts.
